korean.name: Korean Skincare
korean.intro: Dewy textures, honest formulas and the quiet discipline of a real routine — cleansers to creams, chosen one layer at a time.
korean.r1x: An oil first, a gel after. Skin that starts clean holds everything else better.
korean.r2x: Light watery layers, pressed in with palms — this is where the dew comes from.
korean.r3x: Targeted actives, then a moisturizer to keep the whole layer story in place.
korean.e1x: The look is hydration, layered patiently — not shine painted on top.
korean.e2x: A real routine you'll keep beats a ten-step one you won't.

french.name: French Skincare
french.intro: Parisian minimalism: linen light, milk cleansers and creams that do their work without announcing themselves.
french.r1x: Gentle cleansing that respects the skin you already have.
french.r2x: Chosen well, used daily — quiet luxury is mostly consistency.
french.r3x: The French never stop at the jawline. Neither should the ritual.
french.e1x: Soft mornings, marble counters, one shelf of things that earn their place.
french.e2x: The goal isn't new skin. It's yours, at ease.

makeup.name: Makeup
makeup.tagline: Colour with a point of view
makeup.intro: An editorial edit of lips, face and eyes — pigment that stays true, tools worth keeping, nothing you won't use.
makeup.r1x: Cream where skin should look like skin. Powder only where it must stay.
makeup.r2x: Let cheeks and lips share a family — olive, nude, burgundy.
makeup.r3x: Finish with definition once the rest of the face has settled.
makeup.e1x: Swatched in warm light, chosen for real skin tones.
makeup.e2x: A dense rounded brush does three jobs. Keep the good one.

perfumes.name: Perfumes
perfumes.intro: Warm clay, amber and glass. Fragrance chosen the way you'd choose jewellery — slowly, and for yourself.
perfumes.r1x: Wrists, neck, behind the ears — where skin warms the notes open.
perfumes.r2x: Let it dry. Rubbing breaks the top notes before they've spoken.
perfumes.r3x: An unscented cream underneath makes any fragrance last longer.
perfumes.e1x: The first hour is the introduction. The base is who it really is.
perfumes.e2x: Bottles that look right on the shelf you already own.

offers.name: Offers
offers.intro: Every offer here shows the true original price next to the new one. When it's gone, it's gone — no invented urgency.
offers.r1x: Every strikethrough is the price the piece actually sold for.
offers.r2x: A countdown only appears when an offer truly expires.
offers.r3x: Order request first, confirmation and transfer details in chat.
offers.e1x: If nothing is on offer, this page says so — plainly.
offers.e2x: Offers rotate through every department, not just leftovers.
